## What changed and why? / 改了什么，为什么？

<!-- Explain the problem and the resulting behavior. Keep one concern per PR. -->
<!-- 说明具体问题与修改后的行为，每个 PR 聚焦一件事。 -->

## Related issue / 关联 Issue

<!-- Link an issue if one exists. Discuss new features first; small fixes and docs can be submitted directly. -->
<!-- 有关联 Issue 时请填写。新功能请先讨论，小修复与文档可直接提交。 -->

## Validation / 如何验证

<!-- List commands and results, tested OS/architecture, and anything you could not test. -->
<!-- 填写运行的命令与结果、验证的平台和架构，并说明尚未验证的部分。 -->

## Screenshots / 截图

<!-- For UI changes, add before/after screenshots with credentials and personal data removed. -->
<!-- 界面改动请附前后截图，先移除凭据和个人数据。无界面改动可删除本节。 -->

## Checklist / 检查清单

- [ ] I reviewed the diff and can explain the change / 已检查差异并能解释改动
- [ ] Relevant checks pass, or failures are explained above / 相关检查通过，或已说明失败原因
- [ ] Behavior changes include appropriate regression coverage / 行为变更有适当回归验证
- [ ] App text changes update all four locales; website changes update zh/en/ja / 应用文案同步四种语言，官网同步中英日
- [ ] No credentials, local data or unredacted logs are included / 未包含凭据、本机数据或未脱敏日志

<!-- For security vulnerabilities use SECURITY.md's private reporting channels instead of a public PR. -->
<!-- 安全漏洞请通过 SECURITY.md 的私密渠道报告，不要公开利用细节。 -->
